author: GameTrailers
description:
Pokemon Red and Blue just released, your parents bought you a Gameboy for your birthday, Spice Girls were playing on the radio, life was good. 1996 was 30 years ago! And now, The Pokemon Company is poised to celebrate that in a big way with a livestream ready to reveal all the ways in which they plan to do so throughout the year. Will we finally get a glimpse at Pokemon gen 10? Is Pokemon Wind and Waves a real thing? Expect to get updates across all avenues of Pokemon, including Pokopia, Pokemon TCG, the anime, Pokemon games, and more. Join IGN at 6am PT, 9am ET as we react live alongside you. Stick around after the Pokemon Presents for a live discussion with the IGN NVC crew for expert and fan discussion on all things Pokemon and Nintendo. 

#IGN #Gaming #Pokemon
title: Pokemon Presents: 30th Anniversary Livestream Watch Party & Post Show

description:

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Until Then: Afterimages announcement trailer for this upcoming DLC for the narrative adventure game. The Afterimages DLC features two new chapters. Sofia returns home to memories she left behind. Mark meets a new lover and an old friend. On their own, they explore what it means to carry on living in the presence of absence. 

Play fresh minigames from tarot to baking, interact with engaging in-game phone apps for dating and video content, and run into beloved characters, old and new, across two chapters of gameplay.

A fateful meeting sets off a chain reaction, upending Mark's life in Until Then. People disappear and memories prove unreliable. Uncover a hidden truth with Mark and his friends in this narrative adventure and race to unravel the mystery before it's too late.

Until Then: Afterimages will be available in 2026 on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and Steam.
title: Until Then: Afterimages DLC - Official Reveal Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026

description:
Gallipoli, the upcoming authentic FPS set on the Ottoman Fronts of WW1, reveals a new map: The siege of Kut Al Amara. Watch the Gallipoli: The siege of Kut Al Amara trailer to see what to expect.

Prepare for relentless WW1 beach landings and desert warfare across the Ottoman Fronts in Gallipoli. Fight across battlefields ranging from Gallipoli to Lower Mesopotamia with realistic weaponry, historical classes and unforgiving gameplay. Gallipoli will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Microsoft PC, and Epic Games Store in 2026.

description:
Samson: A Tyndalston Story gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the new Samson: A Tyndalston Story trailer for this upcoming pressure-driven action experience built around debt, consequences, and survival in one of the most unforgiving cities imaginable. Samson: A Tyndalston Story will be available on Steam and Epic Games Store on April 8, 2026.

Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

description:

Outbound will be available on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Nintendo Switch.

Build your own home on wheels and live sustainably off-grid. Craft workstations and power supplies, source energy from the sun, wind, or water, upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and explore a colorful world with up to 4 players.

author: GameTrailers
description:
In this next standalone entry of the We Were Here series, you and your partner wake up inside a mysterious facility. Strange machinery surrounds you, and a calm, confident voice guides you through a series of assignments. Often separated and equipped with different tools, you’ll need to rely on your walkie-talkies to communicate clearly and work together. Each assignment introduces new asymmetrical puzzles that can only be solved through cooperation and trust. 

We Were Here Tomorrow is coming to PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. Head over to Steam and add the game to your Wishlist.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the creepy Granny: Escape Together trailer for this co-op horror game that blends stealth, exploration, and puzzle-solving. In Granny: Escape Together, players must escape a terrifying house filled with traps, secrets, and relentless danger. Granny: Escape Together is available on PC, and it is coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One.

On a dark evening walk through a sinister forest, you witness a strange ritual - an old woman dancing in the shadows. Before you can react, a sudden blow sends you into darkness. When you wake up, you find yourself trapped inside Granny’s eerie house, with only five days to escape. Inside, every creaking floorboard and distant sound could mean danger. Players must explore the house, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets of this cursed place while avoiding Granny, who is always closer than she seems.
title: Granny: Escape Together - Official Console Announce Trailer

description: Check out 'The Pit' Co-op Mode Gameplay Trailer for God of War Sons of Sparta, the latest 2D action platformer Metroidvania game developed by Mega Cat Studios and Sony Santa Monica Studios. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op in The Pit for God of War Sons of Sparta, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Rebecca Hanssen (who plays Damiane), Stewart Scudamore (who plays Oongka), and Alec Newman (who plays Kliff) for a behind-the-scenes look at Crimson Desert. The voice actors give insight into their characters and the process of bringing them to life. Crimson Desert will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), and the Mac App Store on March 19, 2026.

Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.
